The red shift is actually one of the lines of evidence for the expansion. Basically the faster the object is moving away the longer the wavelength and the lower the frequency. This Doppler Effect is the same as what happens when you hear a siren approaching or receding and the pitch varies. This gives a 'snapshot in time' of the speed at which an object is receding when it is observed. One can get an objective idea of the distance from observations of objects such as type1 supernovae that produce a known spectrum of light. This shift shows that the universe is expanding because the vast majority of objects (galaxies, etc.) have such a redshift which means they are 'moving away'. Wikipedia has an article on this that you might find interesting.

In lieu of an [earlier discussion](https://voat.co/v/asdf/comments/949388) combined with [today's news](https://voat.co/v/announcements/comments/1004026/new) from @Atko, I've re-examined partnering to establish an ad network on Voat. You should go read the threads, especially the first one. @SamBone raised some good points, a couple of which are still being thought over.

For brevity's sake, I'll refer to our ad network as "ethicaladnet".

My marketing friend, mentioned in the first link, had mixed feelings about the announcement. He loves to be "first" at things-- not to be a dick, but more just to see if he can *do* it. At the same time, we were both really happy to see that some of the restrictions (like banning animated ads) aligned with the approach we'd discussed for ethicaladnet. In either case, this is still something we want to try. I want to try it out of curiosity. He wants to try it for the challenge and the chance to add another "badge" to his resume (achievement hunter...).

We discussed how our version of an ad network might be implemented without undercutting Voat's. I want to try this out, but I don't want to compete with Voat's own ad strategy. That would be counterproductive and might endanger the site's future. As well, I think we can contribute to Voat's overall strategy since doing our own thing with ethicaladnet will allow us to take risks that the Voat admins may not be able to or simply don't have the time to try. Then, I can share what works and doesn't work for subverses, individual subverse communities, and ad-buyers with the admins and the Voat community at large.

To that end, the "old" layout for ethicaladnet ads has been scrapped and we've settled on a new, more concise (and limited) layout. /v/asdf's sidebar has already been updated with the current iteration. If you remember how the old layout looked, most of the text-ad placement has been scrapped. The additional text ads were scrapped because it pushed Voat's "official" ad much too far down the page.

Instead, we'll be focusing exclusively on png/jpg-format ad placement above the search bar. As can be seen, a range of sizes (and prices) are offered. We've purposely increased the pricing to be higher than that which Voat offers it's official ad space so as to make Voat's slightly more attractive.

The idea of keeping a small text section for three to five "sponsored" links is still being kicked around, as you can see. My friend thought these could be offered exclusively and cheaply to Voat community members as cross-subverse promotions. I personally wish there was a way it could actually be pushed down further, beneath the official Voat ad. Maybe I'll hit up /v/CustomizingVoat and see if they have any CSS magicks that could be used to do that.

I have to admit that I'm excited at the possibility of launching ethicaladnet, especially for the various comic book subverses I run. Through my friend, I have access to some pretty big names in the comic book and technology industries. I just don't have a budget to support that access. The dough would indirectly help me obtain some exclusive content, and... (no jinx no jinx no jinx)... POSSIBLY some AMAs that would piss. Reddit. The fuck. *Off*. So, yeah, very, very, very excited.

I think I'll be opening this up to discussion and feedback on /v/comicbooks, /v/marvel, and /v/bigboobscosplay tonight.
